lines.en: label iosummer2nightgen:
scene iosummer2nightgen
I give Io a call right as she’s about to leave work and the two of us make plans to meet up at the bathhouse and walk around the city for a little while before she heads back to the dorms.
lines.zh: Io 正要下班时我给她打了个电话，我们约在澡堂碰头，在她回宿舍之前绕着城里走一走。

lines.en: I let her lead the way seeing as she appears to know this area like the back of her hand, but this ultimately gives her the opportunity to wander into every single store that’s still open and buy food from all of them.
lines.zh: 看样子她对这一带熟得像自家后院，我就让她带路；结果这反倒给了她机会，把每一家还开着的店都逛进去，每家都买点吃的。

lines.en: Why she can’t just decide on one, I have no idea. But it seems like this isn’t the first time something like this has happened as most shopkeepers seem to recognize her right away.
lines.zh: 她为什么就不能只挑一家，我完全不懂。不过看多数店主都立刻认出了她，这种事看来不是头一回发生了。

lines.en: I’m not sure if it’s because she works right around the corner or because there aren’t many green-haired girls with twintails running around Kumon-mi, but I find it a little surprising nonetheless.
lines.zh: 我不确定是因为她就在拐角上班，还是因为 Kumon-mi 没几个绿发双马尾的姑娘到处跑，但总之我觉得有点意外。

lines.en: Not because she’s recognized, though...but because even though every single shopkeeper is female, Io doesn’t seem averse to any.
lines.zh: 不过让我意外的不是她被认出来……而是尽管每个店主都是女性，Io 却似乎对谁都不排斥。

lines.en: scene black
It gets me to thinking that maybe the problem isn’t someone’s sex at all...and that specific genitalia just...gives certain people a disadvantage when it comes to her or something.
lines.zh: 这让我开始想，也许问题根本不在于某人的性别……而是特定的那套器官……在面对她时就是会让某些人吃亏之类的。

lines.en: Honestly, I have no clue. Io’s very vocal about who she is, but not at all vocal about why she’s like that or what may have happened to make her that way.
lines.zh: 说实话我一点头绪也没有。Io 很坦率地说自己是什么样的人，却只字不提为什么会变成这样、又发生过什么。

lines.en: I guess she’s just the type that needs to warm up to people...and I guess she has a harder time warming up to people that give off certain auras.
lines.zh: 我想她只是那种需要先和人混熟的类型……而散发某种气场的人，她大概更难亲近。

lines.en: Not that I believe in “auras” or anything. I’ve just heard of animals that can identify a human’s sex by their scent alone.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我相信什么「气场」。我只是听说过，有些动物光靠气味就能分辨人类的性别。

lines.en: Maybe Io is just an animal?
lines.zh: 也许 Io 只是只动物？

lines.en: Maybe Io just likes my scent?
lines.zh: 也许 Io 只是喜欢我的气味？

lines.en: $ io_love += 1
Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!
lines.zh: Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!
